oracle.gate: Exact archived names, quoted ability snippets, printed mana cost, color identity for source candidate, commander, and fixtures.

scenarios.candidate_state: Gwendlyn and Alchemist controlled continuously since start of turn, untapped, Gwendlyn not shrouded, on your turn, stack empty, one opponent has 3 cards
scenarios.baseline_state: Gwendlyn available but no Alchemist; Opposition Agent retained instead
scenarios.fixed_actions: Gwendlyn taps for first legal random-discard target; Alchemist taps to untap Gwendlyn; second Gwendlyn activation while opponent hand remains >0
scenarios.prohibited_inference: infinite discard; multiple opponent AI search events

scenarios.candidate_state: Pemmin's Aura grants shroud to Gwendlyn before Alchemist tries to target; opposing tutor spell is on the stack, Alchemist controller can respond
scenarios.baseline_state: Opposition Agent in hand, enough mana and priority to flash before opponent tutor resolves
scenarios.fixed_actions: Candidate untap target fails while shrouded; baseline cast Opposition Agent by flash then resolve tutor search with Agent replacement; track search-control event only, not card valuation
scenarios.prohibited_inference: agent necessarily wins; automatic random-discard effect

scenarios.candidate_state: First main-phase representative mana fixture: available one U, one B and one colorless, red missing; one spare land discardable
scenarios.baseline_state: Mox Diamond 0 mana with same spare land; ability may produce missing R
scenarios.fixed_actions: Mox enters only with land discard and produces R; Aetheric Amplifier requires three mana and cannot produce R on the same first simulated window

scenarios.candidate_state: Post-transformation Bolas the Arisen with 5 loyalty, an untapped Amplifier, 4 generic mana, priority during controller main phase with empty stack
scenarios.baseline_state: Mox Diamond retained, no Amplifier; same transformed commander
scenarios.fixed_actions: Activate Amplifier as sorcery paying 4 and tap, double Bolas loyalty 5 to 10; do NOT refresh planeswalker loyalty activation quota
scenarios.prohibited_inference: automatically eligible for -12; extra activation/ultimate or win

scenarios.candidate_state: Mai and Zuko in play, untapped Enigma Jewel, Basalt Monolith and Rings of Brighthearth controlled; 0 floating ordinary mana at start; other opponent response absent; demonstrate one legal bounded Basalt/Rings stack sequence
scenarios.baseline_state: The Enigma Jewel absent (An Offer kept); no extra usable mana at this window
scenarios.fixed_actions: Jewel entering tapped cannot tap in that turn; on later turn untapped Jewel generates 2 restricted C only for activated abilities. Basalt tap produces 3 ordinary C, spend 3 on untap, pay Rings 2 from Jewel mana, let copy resolve, tap Basalt once, let original resolve; record resource count and no infinite inference
scenarios.prohibited_inference: infinite engine; Jewel mana may cast artifacts; sorcery craft at instant speed

scenarios.candidate_state: Opponent noncreature spell on stack and pilot has U floating, candidate card is Jewel instead of An Offer
scenarios.baseline_state: An Offer You Can't Refuse held with U mana and pilot priority
scenarios.fixed_actions: Baseline may counter target noncreature spell and its controller makes 2 Treasure; candidate Jewel doesn't counter it and restricted C cannot cast counterspell even with flash artifact permission
scenarios.prohibited_inference: actual opponent win prevented; universal protection/stack win probabilities

validation_gates: Reconcile source 62 roster, named M5 swaps and archived approval list logical hash; source 99+one commander and candidate only single replaced slot.
Every rules-effect operation explicitly validates turn, controlled physical card, tap/summoning-sickness, target legality, required mana and stack resolution; failure cannot silently change state.
Oracle-gate all scripted text and relevant costs from frozen archive; reject unrecognized Oracle changes.
Six matching scenario IDs; per-case baseline/candidate finite traces, adversarial negative tests, and deterministic receipt under hash-seed-pinned CI.
No manufactured random deck hands, no actual opponent decisions, no unbounded loops, no claimed same-seed Phase B performance.
No changes to core M3 or canonical decklists, M6 still in progress, independent Pass C is not earned.
